The player must navigate toward the open-front workshop and look at the smithing table placed at spawn-relative [5, 1, 5]. max_distance=10 ensures the player has moved closer to the workshop (spawn distance is ~7.1 blocks, so they must at least face it from near spawn or approach further), and facing_tolerance=60 ensures they are actually looking toward the smithing table rather than accidentally triggering completion while facing away.

scene_description: A flat grass clearing with a small open-front workshop built from cobblestone walls and oak plank floor/roof. The workshop contains a smithing table (center), a crafting table (left-back corner), and a barrel (right-back corner) as distractors. A villager stands outside near the entrance. The open front faces the player spawn, making the smithing table visible from spawn.
task_text: Find the smithing table in the nearby workshop.
design_notes: The workshop is 5x5 blocks (X:3-7, Z:3-7) with walls on three sides (left/right/back) and completely open on the Z=3 face (facing player). The smithing table is at center (5,1,5). The crafting table and barrel serve as visual distractors. The villager at (1,0,2) adds environmental context. A lantern at (-2,1,0) provides ambient detail. The air-fill clears all natural trees in the area for unobstructed navigation.
